text:
amanda (sec): security scan flagged backup-agent v2.5.0 writing an `encryption_context` JSON blob to /var/tmp/backup-multipart-<id>.meta with 0644 perms during assemble. not keys, but tenant ids + cmk alias. potential compliance leak.
tom (infra): thanks — which flow? upload multipart finalize?
amanda (sec): yes, finalizer path. sample blob shows {"cmk":"alias/prod-backups", "tenant":"tenant-789", "ctx":"user:svc-account"} 
sree (sre): i saw a rise in object-store 403s last night; unrelated? link to ops logs redacted: https://logs.internal/obj/abc
amanda (sec): maybe unrelated but this metadata being world-readable on hosts is the main issue. also our current RBAC grants backup-agent kms:Encrypt,Decrypt at IAM role level. we should remove Decrypt.
restore-runner: we use decrypt during restore to validate checksums in restore pipeline. if we remove Decrypt for agent, restores need a different flow.
tom (infra): proposed short-term mitigation: change temp file path to run in tmpfs (/dev/shm), file mode 0600, and avoid dumping raw `ctx` key; replace with SHA256(ctx) in any on-disk artifact. I'll open PR.
amanda (sec): +1. also add immediate scrub on exit and ensure unlink happens before process exit to reduce TOCTOU.
sree (sre): longer-term: split privileges. backup upload role gets kms:Encrypt only. restore service can assume `restore-runner` role that is granted kms:Decrypt via a short-lived KMS grant (or use KMS-GenerateDataKey workflow where plaintext key never touches disk). we should evaluate both patterns.
amanda (sec): prefer GenerateDataKey/ENVELOPE so plaintext key is only in memory for a couple ms. If restore flow needs decrypt for existing objects, we can issue a temporary grant.
compliance-bot: RULE CHECK: storing tenant identifiers in host tmp with open perms may violate data-handling policy DH-4. Escalate to compliance. Ticket: CMP-2026 created.
tom (infra): PR: https://git.internal/infra/backup-agent/pull/501 - implements tmpfs write, 0600, ctx-hash, and `--no-ctx-on-disk` flag. adds unit test ensuring no plaintext ctx files persist.
sree (sre): I'll run targeted bucket scan across `prod-backup-*` and `tenant-archive-*` for objects with metadata header `x-backup-encryption-context`. plan to run at 04:00 UTC. list of high-risk buckets requested by amanda.
amanda (sec): high-risk list: prod-backups, prod-archive, tenant-archive-01..05. If scan finds raw ctx in object metadata, remediation = rotate CMK for impacted objects + re-encrypt copies, and notify affected tenants per policy.
sree (sre): note: CMK rotation is heavy. alternative: remove metadata and re-kms-encrypt with same key? but policy requires rotation if tenant identifiers leaked. we'll coordinate with legal.
amanda (sec): severity = medium (metadata only), vector = host tmp file exposure. timeline: patch rolled 03:10, discovered by vuln scan 03:42. action items: 1) tom - deploy PR to canary; 2) sree - run bucket scan and report; 3) infra - update IAM to remove kms:Decrypt from backup-agent role and add runbook for restore-role assumption; 4) compliance - CMP-2026 followup.
tom (infra): canary deploy scheduled 05:00 UTC. will post canary results here.
sree (sre): running scan will take ~90 mins for first pass. will prioritize prod-backups. will post findings.
amanda (sec): add a observability alert: logpipeline should redact `encryption_context` value and store only `ctx_hash` and `cmk_alias`. Also add SIEM rule to detect any host files matching /var/tmp/backup-multipart-*.meta older than 5m.
omitted: (system) backup-agent v2.5.0 vulnerability report attached to ticket CMP-2026.
restore-runner: question - for restores, can we implement a privileged service that performs Decrypt in a FIPS-compliant KMS enclave and streams plaintext keys directly into memory for the restore? reduces broad Decrypt grants.
amanda (sec): yes, that's the pattern we want long-term. open RFC to prototype KMS-proxy service.
tom (infra): I'll add unit/integration tests in agent repo to assert: no on-disk ctx, write mode 0600, and immediate unlink. sample test snippet:
```
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir='/dev/shm', delete=False) as f:
    path = f.name
# agent should unlink
assert not os.path.exists(path)
```
sree (sre): noted. will coordinate CMK rotations if scan finds exposed ctx. posting results back here. :white_check_mark:
